name: sprint-report-agent-engine
description: Headless parsing/aggregation + report-generation engine for Webyith daily sprint reports (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/HTML). Run `npm install` once, then `node sprint_engine.js ingest <sprint-folder>` followed by `node build_sprint_report_docx.js <sprint-folder>/_sprint_data.json <output.docx>`.
